manifest.name: Stock Picking Auto Create Lot
manifest.summary: Auto create lots for incoming pickings

DESCRIPTION.text:
This module extends the functionality of stock module to allow auto
create lots for incoming pickings.

USAGE.text:
To use this module you need to:

1.  Go to a *Product \> General Information tab*.
2.  Set a tracking option for this product.
3.  Set auto create lot.
4.  Go to *Inventory \> Incoming* and create one.
5.  Validate picking without lot.

CONFIGURE.text:
To configure this module, you need to:

1.  Go to a *Inventory \> Configuration \> Operation Types*.
2.  Set 'auto create lot' option for this operation type.
3.  Go to a *Inventory \> Master Data \> Products*.
4.  Set 'auto create lot' option for the products you need.


It's possible to configure by code a way to force the setting of the auto lot when
printing the detailed operation labels. To do so, pass the context key `force_auto_lot`
to the report. This is a simple example with a server action, but it can be done with
overriding methods as well:

```xml
     <record id="action_print_detailed_operation" model="ir.actions.server">
          <field name="name">Print detailed operations</field>
          <field name="model_id" ref="stock.model_stock_move_line" />
          <field
                name="binding_model_id"
                ref="stock.model_stock_move_line"
          />
          <field name="binding_view_types">list</field>
          <field name="state">code</field>
          <field name="code">
     if records:
          report = env["ir.actions.report"].sudo()._get_report("my_custom_module.my_custom_report_xml_id")
          action = report.with_context(force_auto_lot=True).report_action(records.ids)
          </field>
     </record>

## GITHUB ISSUES (selected)
### #2237 [IMP] stock_picking_auto_create_lot: add SKU-based lot/serial numbering (pr, closed, 2026)
Improves Stock Picking Auto Create Lot by adding per-product lot/serial generation options.
* Replaced the boolean with `auto_create_lot_option` (Odoo sequence / SKU based).
* Added Inventory setting “SKU Based Numbers Trailing” and applied it to SKU-based numbering.
* Implemented SKU-based lots/serials as `<SKU>-<N>` using an auto-managed per-product `ir.sequence`, with fallback to `stock.lot.serial` when SKU is missing.
* Added migration (bool -> selection), updated docs, and extended tests to keep codecov diff coverage.

### #1903 [IMP] [16.0] stock_picking_auto_create_lot: Make it compatible with Stock Picking Batches (pr, closed, 2025)
This module is incompatible if you perform batches or waves.
Now, on the sanity check, the move lines with auto-generate lots will be skipped.
MT-9566 @moduon @rafaelbn @yajo @fcvalgar @Gelojr @EmilioPascual @sergio-teruel please review if you want 😄

### #1517 [16.0][FIX] stock_picking_auto_create_lot: fix creating lot for 0 qty move lines for serial product (pr, closed, 2024)
Before this commit, when we use `stock_picking_auto_create_lot` for serial product with planned tansfer and set `quantity_done` that is less than demand, it will create lots record for all demand quantity and some records are quantity `0.00`.
Eg, our demand is `5` and `quantity_done` is `3`. It will create `5` stock lot records and `2` records are quantity `0.00`.
This commit is to address this issue.
@qrtl

### #1537 [15.0][FIX] stock_picking_auto_create_lot: Lots repeated for different stock move lines with the same product (pr, closed, 2024)
For one stock move if I create two sml's and validate the picking two lots are created but the two sml have the same lot (The first lot created)
cc @Tecnativa TT48308
ping @carlosdauden @rousseldenis

### #1601 [15.0][IMP] stock_picking_auto_create_lot: Use Odoo core mechanism to create lots in pickings filling lot_name field instead of create all lots. (pr, closed, 2024)
[IMP] stock_picking_auto_create_lot: Use Odoo core mechanism to create lots in pickings filling lot_name field instead of create all lots.
Why this PR... well... I have noticed that if you install product_expiry, for example, you can set the expiration date in stock move lines directly, but stock_picking_auto_create_lot module break this date creating the lots with other dates (the default dates based on product time fields)...
Reviwing this module I think that is better let Odoo create the lots filling the lot_name field on stock move lines... 
After this PR, I will review future versions
ping @carlosdauden @CarlosRoca13 @rousseldenis
